name: StudyLoop
display_name: StudyLoop · 学习闭环 / Personalized Learning Plugin for AI Agents
summary: A learning plugin for AI agents: memory, mastery grading, material retrieval, review scheduling, artifact scaffolding.

optional.note: Nothing is required. Any engine found on the machine is used; nothing is installed automatically.
optional.pdf: pymupdf / pdfplumber / pypdf / PyPDF2 / pdfminer / pdftotext / mutool / LibreOffice
optional.office: python-pptx / openpyxl / pandas / LibreOffice / antiword / catdoc

capabilities.memory: Writes L1 every turn and injects the L3 profile plus progress; records only inside a course folder
capabilities.mastery: BKT posterior probability with a 0.95 gate; concept/design knowledge points need a qualitative pass; hints are not counted as evidence
capabilities.retrieval: BM25 keyword search with CJK bigrams
capabilities.artifacts: Artifact scaffolding: four templates in Chinese and English, structural validation accepting either language, questions into the bank, path linkage
capabilities.brief: Generation input assembly: materials + mastery + errors + progress

limits: Writes memory only inside a course folder
Artifact bodies are produced by the agent; the plugin provides structure, input and validation only
